name: @opening-cross/video
description: The Opening Bell product film, built with Remotion from real recorded screens and measured numbers.

scripts.render:1080: remotion render src/index.ts Film out/opening-bell-1080p.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
scripts.render:4k: remotion render src/index.ts Film out/opening-bell-4k.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16 --scale 2
scripts.render:60: remotion render src/index.ts Short out/opening-bell-60s.mp4 --codec h264 --crf 16
